Definition: from G303 and G2147; to find out:--find.
BiblicalUsage: The disciples find the child Jesus sitting in the temple, and in Troas the brethren find Paul and urge him to stay seven days. The word means to find out after looking, to come upon what was sought.
TheologicalSignificance: A word for finding after seeking holds no doctrine of its own; its pleasure is the scene, of shepherds finding the child and friends finding Paul.
RelatedPeople: Mary, Mother of Jesus; Joseph, Husband of Mary; Paul
RelatedEvents: The Boy Jesus in the Temple
